content.short: Avantis is an advanced decentralized protocol designed for seamless decentralized derivatives within the Web3 ecosystem on Base.
content.description: Decentralized leverage hub on Base for trading FX and crypto. Built organically for the Web3 ecosystem, Avantis provides an essential suite of services focused heavily on decentralized derivatives. By operating on Base, it allows users to experience fast execution times while maintaining strong cryptographic security. The protocol is designed to be highly interoperable, aiming to become a cornerstone of the DeFi Dapps sector. Through continuous innovation, Avantis contributes to the broader vision of a decentralized, permissionless digital economy.
